explanation: This lemma gives the derivative of `fdBoundarySegment4`, which is the library's own boundary-segment definition (a shifted `AffineMap.lineMap` running from ρ to -1/2 + H·i). The proof just takes `.deriv` of the library's own lemma `hasDerivAt_fdBoundarySegment4`. Mathlib does have the general fact that the derivative of an affine line map is the difference of its endpoints. But that is a generic tool applied to a library definition, so it does not count as a match here. All the mathematical content lies in the library's definition, and I found no Mathlib declaration about this segment.
